authority: DECISIONS.md, FLOW_FORMAT.md, and UX_CONTRACT.md; these are obligations for a later implementation, not claims that an app exists.
cross_cutting_obligations: There is one normalized sample workspace, workspace_alya. Mock auth identities and resumable onboarding drafts do not introduce a production multi-tenant or multi-workspace system. Preserve existing edited business data while setup is drafted; any deliberate replacement on first-use completion follows the exact loss-warning/reset contract.

Task waiting_input covers clarification and missing inputs. Waiting for owner authority uses waiting_approval. Connection storage uses reconnect_required; friendly labels may say Needs reconnect. UI draft aliases must map to canonical data enums.

Logical refs such as taskRequest:current, localSession, localRecoveryGrant, publicProfileSnapshot and onboardingDraft describe local UI/session/editor records needed by these flows. Define explicit versioned schemas for any added persisted extension; do not drop requirements because the base fixture lacks editor/session fields.
All owner routes use local sample-session guard; public/buyer projections never inherit owner-private stores through UI selectors.
Ready/loading/empty/no-results/error/dirty/busy/disabled states correspond to actual local state; preserve work during recovery.
Every control has a step or named shared contract; navigation routes and actual saved record IDs are testable.
Form Enter submits safely; Escape follows explicit overlay policy; Tab/Shift+Tab, roving map/list selection and focus return work; no focus/scroll theft.
Dirty navigation offers Keep editing/Discard/Save where valid; failed Save prevents leaving with false success.
Real browser Back/Forward and direct links preserve trusted route/query context; unknown IDs get app-owned not-found.
Versioned mutations have idempotency, stale-version checks and durable local persistence; no arbitrary timeout-only success.
All sample external effects require appropriate exact-content/version/destination approval; all are simulated and cause no real side effects.
Follow-up commands revalidate current source, connection capability, rule and approval state; reconnect/retry never silently sends.
A source/attachment preview and download must use actual retained content or show an honest unsupported/unavailable state.
Use real file generation for download controls; export owner and buyer/public data through distinct whitelisted projections.
No API keys, real passwords, OAuth tokens or production banking details required; credentials never persisted in mock auth.

Accept user uploads only PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT; maximum 10MiB (10485760 bytes) per file and five files per selection/action. Validate extension/MIME, actual byte size and local storage quota before saving; reject unsupported files with filename-specific error. Treat contents as data; never execute them. Trusted bundled internal SVG portfolio assets are exempt from user-upload policy; this never enables user SVG uploads. Manual text editors may accept Markdown content, while the uploaded text-file format is TXT.

steps.validation: Accept user uploads only PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT; maximum 10MiB (10485760 bytes) per file and five files per selection/action. Validate extension/MIME, actual byte size and local storage quota before saving; reject unsupported files with filename-specific error. Treat contents as data; never execute them. Deduplicate repeated same command; intentional later replacement creates a new version. No arbitrary PDF semantic-extraction claim.
steps.mutation: Create source+attachment with actual metadata, audience=owner, status=processing; supported parser/mock records extracted result or failed reason; ready only when saved content exists.
steps.visible_result: Source row reports real local stage, version, source date; failed row exposes Retry/Replace/Archive.
steps.failure_recovery: Reject unsupported type, more than five files per action, or any file above 10485760 actual bytes before saving that invalid item; preserve filenames for clear errors. Parser/storage error retains recoverable accepted-file metadata and original bytes when possible.
steps.focus: New row and politely announced status; no forced navigation.

steps.validation: Input available and same source version; supported operation.
steps.mutation: New processing attempt for same source; record failure/ready result; update dependent waiting task eligibility without auto-resuming external action.
steps.visible_result: Error replaced by processing then genuine ready/failed result.
steps.failure_recovery: Repeated failure remains actionable; original input preserved.
steps.focus: Source status; keep Retry focus if failure.

steps.validation: Accept user uploads only PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT; maximum 10MiB (10485760 bytes) per file and five files per selection/action. Validate extension/MIME, actual byte size and local storage quota before saving; reject unsupported files with filename-specific error. Treat contents as data; never execute them. Single-file replacement; retain historical evidence version. A manual Markdown body is not permission to upload MD or SVG.
steps.mutation: Create new source version with old content retained; current version processes; linked historical artifact source-version refs unchanged.
steps.visible_result: New version label and processing result; current source consumers can choose updated version deliberately.
steps.failure_recovery: Keep old current ready version if replacement cannot commit; no broken old refs.

steps.visible_result: Updated visibility badge; public/buyer preview includes only approved safe source.
steps.failure_recovery: Retain previous audience on failure/stale review; keep draft for correction.

cross_screen: Delegate source picker uses readiness/audience; portfolio settings selects only allowed sources.
Artifacts retain exact source version/date; changed source signals stale assessment where necessary.
success_assertions: Empty state offers Upload and Add text.
Ready means saved usable content; URL-only remains reference with unknown external contents.
Replacement retains original evidence and links.
Visibility review changes actual public projection only after commit.
negative_assertions: No fake OCR/extraction, external URL crawl, verified expertise, or public publication by upload alone.
Removing source does not silently remove accepted contract/history.
No original private file in public export by default.
